session.title: RJ45 port QA — Claude Code session
session.goal: What the team wanted out of the whole session, in one line
session.setup: Hardware/software state at the start: cameras, calibration, grip, scripts available

episodes.title: Short name, e.g. 'Survey ports'
episodes.trigger: Why this episode started: user request / previous failure / own initiative
episodes.ask: The user's instruction, quoted or closely paraphrased
episodes.interpretation: How Claude understood the ask and the plan it chose (and alternatives it rejected)
actions: Tool/script calls in order, e.g. 'wrote porttest/survey2.py'
observed: What came back: numbers, images, log lines, errors (e.g. 'ray rms 10 mm, pitch 16 mm')

outcome.summary: Result in one or two lines

assumptions.text: Something Claude relied on without checking
Something that was checked and held
Something that later turned out wrong

episodes.human: What the operator did or said: correction, physical help, hint, stop recovery. Empty if none.

missing_capabilities: Tool, sensor view or information that would have avoided a failure
